Parameters.Name: Vault
Parameters.Description: The name of the Vault in 1Password.

Parameters.Name: Token
Parameters.Description: The Service Account Token that is configured to access the specified Vault.

Parameters.Name: Item
Parameters.Description: The name of the credential item in 1Password. This could be the name of a Login object or a Password object.

Parameters.Name: Field
Parameters.Description: The name of the Field to retrieve from the specified Item. For a Login, this would be 'username' or 'password'. For an API Credential this would be 'credential'.

Parameters.Name: KeyVaultUri
Parameters.Description: URI for your Azure Key Vault

Parameters.Name: AuthorityHost
Parameters.Description: Authority host of your Azure infrastructure

Parameters.Name: SecretId
Parameters.Description: Name of your secret in Azure Key Vault

Parameters.Name: KeyVaultUri
Parameters.Description: URI for your Azure Key Vault

Parameters.Name: AuthorityHost
Parameters.Description: Authority host of your Azure infrastructure

Parameters.Name: TenantId
Parameters.Description: Tenant or directory ID in Azure

Parameters.Name: ClientId
Parameters.Description: Application ID in Entra AD

Parameters.Name: ClientSecret
Parameters.Description: Client secret for your application ID

Parameters.Name: SecretId
Parameters.Description: Name of your secret in Azure Key Vault

Parameters.Name: Host
Parameters.Description: The URL to the Secret Server instance. Example: https://example.secretservercloud.com/SecretServer

Parameters.Name: Username
Parameters.Description: The username used to authenticate to the Secret Server instance. NOTE: only applicable if using the `password` grant type.

Parameters.Name: Password
Parameters.Description: The password used to authenticate to the Secret Server instance. NOTE: only applicable if using the `password` grant type.

Parameters.Name: ClientId
Parameters.Description: The client ID used to authenticate to the Secret Server instance. NOTE: only applicable if using the `client_credentials` grant type.

Parameters.Name: ClientSecret
Parameters.Description: The client secret used to authenticate to the Secret Server instance. NOTE: only applicable if using the `client_credentials` grant type.

Parameters.Name: GrantType
Parameters.Description: The grant type used to authenticate to the Secret Server instance. Valid values are `password` or `client_credentials`. Default is `password`. If not provided the default value `password` will be used to maintain backwards compatability.

Parameters.Name: SecretId
Parameters.Description: The ID of the secret in Secret Server. This is the integer ID that is used to retrieve the secret from Secret Server.

Parameters.Name: SecretFieldName
Parameters.Description: The name of the field in the secret that contains the credential value. NOTE: The field must exist.
